entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Subhash Bisaria,Rohit Kumar Verma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Sri P. Chakravarty, advocate, has put in appearance by way of filing vakalatnama on behalf of the complainant and the same is taken on record.
Heard counsel for the applicants, counsel for the complainant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The instant application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 274 of 2018, under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 469 and 471 of IPC Police Station- Husainganj District- Lucknow.
The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant matter due to ulterior motive.

He submits that the applicant was initially appointed on the post of Assistant Teacher in intermediate college and thereafter, she was Smt. Sadhna Chooramani @ Sadhna Bedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ... on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58549437/
1 promoted and was posted as Principal.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that there was some dispute in between the Committee of Management and the Principal with respect to day to day administration and therefore, in retaliation thereof, the first information report has been lodged in the fag end of her retirement.

He also submits that allegation is that some fake marksheet is produced for getting the appointment in the college by way of interpolation in the date of birth though, after the departmental inquiry, no proper opportunity of hearing was accorded to her and thus, the applicant has been made scapegoat.
He also added that the applicant has been a teacher since long back and there is no possibility that she will flee away from the investigation proceedings.

He added that there is case criminal history of the applicant which has been explained and no further custodial interrogation is required as, the chargesheet has been filed, thus, submission is that the applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel appearing for the complainant has opposed the contentions to the tooth and nails and submits that the applicant is involved in committing offence as it is apparent from the departmental inquiry and after the same, the first information report has been lodged.
He further added that the matter is serious as the fabrication was found in the record of the applicant which was initially submitted at the time of appointment.

He next added that there are other criminal history of the applicant wherein, she was found involved in committing cheat & fraud by misappropriating the huge amount thus, submission is that the applicant is not entitled for any relief.

Learned A.G.A. appearing for the State has also opposed the contentions of counsel for the applicant and submitted that after thorough investigation, it was found that the applicant was involved in committing offence as such, chargesheet has been filed and therefore, she is not entitled for any relief.

Having heard learned counsels for the parties and after perusal of material placed on record, it transpires that the applicant was working as a Teacher in the intermediate college and in fact she worked up till the post of Principal and it seems that later on a complaint was made against her,
while alleging that some forgery is committed by her in the record for her initial appointment and the contention of counsel for the applicant is that the applicant was not given the proper opportunity of hearing before the Inquiry Officer and the Inquiry Officer has wrongly reached to the conclusion that she was involved in committing forgery in the records.

Further, this Court has also noticed that the applicant has explained the criminal history and chargesheet has been filed and there is no complaint that she has ever absconded from the Investigation proceedings.
It is admitted that bailable warrant has been issued against her, but it seems that so as the anticipatory bail application is filed, that is of no avail.

Considering the aforesaid aspect of the matter, the instant regular anticipatory bail is hereby allowed while granting bail to the applicant namely, Smt. Sadhna Chooramani @ Sadhna Bedi till disposal of the trial subject to the following conditions :-
(i) that the applicant shall make herself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;

2 (ii) that the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence;
(iii) that the applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the court'
(iv) that the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted; and (v). that the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
